svg.text: LedgerLens architecture: from shoebox records to a lender-ready credit file
One channel-agnostic core serves the live demo and the evaluation harness. Meta models extract; code computes, tiers and checks; the trader confirms.
web chat today; WhatsApp = a second
thin adapter over the same core (D-06)
30 msgs / 10 min per IP, 60 calls/h global
same code path for demo and eval
errors logged as class + status, no content
hashed session IDs, no names stored
line sums vs total, card holds,
share of income backed by T1/T2,
EVALUATION AND ASSURANCE (calls Core.handle() directly, same code as the demo)
Dashed = planned or in progress. D-xx = decision in docs/DECISIONS.md; E-xxx = evaluation run.
